title: Rcpp Port of Linkage Disequilibrium Graphical Models
Rcpp Port of Linkage Disequilibrium Graphical Models
text: Start LDGM edge list. R-facing node ids one-based, like ordinary R row/column indices. File readers convert upstream GraphLD zero-based files boundary. ldgm_precision objects carry variant metadata support selected Schur-complement views, diagonal updates, scalar scaling, duplicate-index variant solves.
code: edges <- ldgm_edge_list(   from = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 2L),   to = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 2L, 3L),   weight = c(2, 3, 4, 0.1, 0.2) ) precision <- ldgm_sparse_precision(edges) precision #> 3 x 3 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #> #> [1,] 2.0 0.1 . #> [2,] 0.1 3.0 0.2 #> [3,] .   0.2 4.0  x <- c(1, 2, 3) ldgm_precision_multiply(precision, x) #> [1]  2.2  6.7 12.4 ldgm_precision_solve(precision, x) #> [1] 0.4698492 0.6030151 0.7198492 ldgm_precision_logdet(precision) #> [1] 3.173041 variant_info <- data.frame(   index = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 3L),   SNP = c("rs1", "rs1_proxy", "rs2", "rs3") ) block <- ldgm_precision(precision, variant_info)  selected <- ldgm_precision_select(block, c(1L, 3L)) ldgm_precision_matrix(selected) #> 2 x 2 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #> #> [1,]  1.996666667 -0.006666667 #> [2,] -0.006666667  3.986666667  updated <- ldgm_precision_update_element(selected, index = 1L, value = 0.5) ldgm_precision_multiply(updated, c(1, 1)) #> [1] 2.49 3.98  ldgm_variant_solve(block, c(1, 2, 3, 4)) #> [1] 1.4556114 1.4556114 0.8877722 0.9556114

title: Rcpp Port of Linkage Disequilibrium Graphical Models
text: native LDGM construction kernels consume canonical tree-diff tables. real work come ldgm_tree_tables_from_tskit("file.trees") vendored tskit C adapter. toy example uses table interface without requiring Python external data.
code: initial_edges <- data.frame(   left = c(0, 0),   right = c(1, 1),   parent = c(3L, 3L),   child = c(1L, 2L) ) empty_transitions <- data.frame(transition = integer(), left = numeric()) empty_edges_out <- data.frame(transition = integer(), child = integer()) empty_edges_in <- data.frame(   transition = integer(), left = numeric(), right = numeric(),   parent = integer(), child = integer() ) empty_node_state <- data.frame(   transition = integer(), node = integer(), prev_parent = integer(),   curr_parent = integer(), time = numeric(), curr_num_samples = integer() ) mutations <- data.frame(   mutation = c(1L, 2L),   site = c(1L, 2L),   position = c(0.1, 0.2),   node = c(1L, 2L),   ancestral_state = c("A", "C"),   derived_state = c("G", "T") )  tables <- ldgm_tree_tables(   initial_edges = initial_edges,   transitions = empty_transitions,   edges_out = empty_edges_out,   edges_in = empty_edges_in,   node_state = empty_node_state,   sample_nodes = 1:2,   mutations = mutations )  toy_ldgm <- ldgm_make_ldgm(tables, path_threshold = 4, return_intermediates = TRUE) toy_ldgm$bricked_edges #>   id left right parent child #> 1  0    0     1      3     1 #> 2  1    0     1      3     2 toy_ldgm$snplist #>   index anc_alleles deriv_alleles #> 1     0           A             G #> 2     1           C             T ldgm_return_edgelist(toy_ldgm$graph) #>   from to weight #> 1    0  1      0

what: GraphREML kernel and score-test HDF5 output
title: Rcpp Port of Linkage Disequilibrium Graphical Models
text: current graphREML surface serial core workflow. useful native experiments conformance work, yet full GraphLD CLI parity.
code: z <- c(1.2, -0.4, 0.7) annotations <- cbind(baseline = 1, coding = c(0, 1, 0))  fit <- ldgm_run_reml(   precision,   z,   annotations,   sample_size = 1000,   num_iterations = 2,   diagonal_method = "exact",   num_jackknife_blocks = 1 ) round(fit$parameters, 3) #>  baseline    coding #>  4482.845 -1575.055 signif(fit$heritability, 3) #> baseline   coding #> 0.001980 0.000485  h5 <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5") variant_data <- data.frame(   CHR = c(1L, 1L, 1L),   POS = c(10L, 20L, 30L),   RSID = c("rs1", "rs2", "rs3") ) ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5(   h5,   variant_data = variant_data,   gradient = c(0.1, -0.2, 0.3),   trait_name = "toy",   jackknife_blocks = c(0L, 1L, 1L),   parameters = fit$parameters,   jackknife_parameters = fit$jackknife_params,   compression = "none",   overwrite = TRUE ) ldgm_read_score_test_hdf5(h5, "toy") #> $variant_data #>   CHR POS RSID jackknife_blocks #> 1   1  10  rs1                0 #> 2   1  20  rs2                1 #> 3   1  30  rs3                1 #> #> $trait_names #> [1] "toy" #> #> $trait_name #> [1] "toy" #> #> $gradient #> [1]  0.1 -0.2  0.3 #> #> $parameters #> [1]  4482.845 -1575.055 #> #> $jackknife_parameters #>          [,1]      [,2] #> [1,] 4482.845 -1575.055

what: Write GraphLD-Style Score-Test HDF5 Output — ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5
title: Write GraphLD-Style Score-Test HDF5 Output — ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5
text: Writes HDF5 layout used GraphLD's graphREML score-test path: root metadata attributes, /row_data/{CHR,POS,RSID,jackknife_blocks}, /groups, /traits/<trait_name>/gradient, optionally /traits/<trait_name>/parameters/{parameters,jackknife_parameters}. Native HDF5 support linked CRAN hdf5lib package, including bundled LZF/gzip filters.

title: Write GraphLD-Style Score-Test HDF5 Output — ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5
code: ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5(   file,   variant_data,   gradient,   trait_name = "trait",   jackknife_blocks = NULL,   parameters = NULL,   jackknife_parameters = NULL,   overwrite = FALSE,   compression = c("lzf", "gzip", "none"),   chunk_size = 1000L,   source = paste0("RcppLDGM v", utils::packageVersion("RcppLDGM")) )

title: Write GraphLD-Style Score-Test HDF5 Output — ldgm_write_score_test_hdf5
text: file Output HDF5 path. Existing files updated appending new trait unless overwrite = TRUE. variant_data Data frame CHR, POS, either RSID SNP. gradient Numeric variant score/gradient vector, one value per row variant_data. trait_name HDF5 trait group name /traits. Must contain /. jackknife_blocks Optional integer jackknife block assignment vector. omitted, variant_data$jackknife_blocks used present, otherwise variants assigned block zero. parameters Optional numeric fitted parameter vector stored trait's parameters group GraphLD score-test /O compatibility. jackknife_parameters Optional numeric matrix one row per jackknife replicate one column per parameters entry. Required parameters supplied. overwrite TRUE, replace existing file writing. compression One "lzf", "gzip", "none". "lzf" matches GraphLD's current score-test output. chunk_size Positive HDF5 chunk length. source Source string stored root HDF5 attribute.
